notes: Posted 4 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'starting 6': WYS (Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough), Tatooine: Cantina, Tatooine, Tatooine: Docking Bay 94, The Signal and Squadron Assignments; these count toward the 60. The Signal is the starting Interrupt ('Why start with signal?') and deploys Squadron Assignments (posted 'SQUADRAN ASSIGNMENT'), the starting Effect.
The header line 'interupts and effects 24' was mis-parsed as a card and removed.
Two-sided generic cards dested the Light pages: Tatooine (Light) (Premiere), Tatooine: Cantina (Light) (posted 'CANTINA').

Posted 'control combo' dested Control & Tunnel Vision (the Light Control combo); 'weapon levitation' dested the Light Jabba's Palace Weapon Levitation; 'nar shadda wind chimes combo' dested Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes & Out Of Somewhere; 'hojix combo' dested Houjix & Out Of Nowhere.

Posted 'owen lars & beru' dested Owen Lars & •Beru Lars; 'captain han' dested Captain Han Solo; 'chewie with blaster' dested Chewie With Blaster Rifle; 'raltir freighter cap' dested Ralltiir Freighter Captain; 'red squadran 1' dested Red Squadron 1; 'obiwans saber' dested Obi-Wan's Lightsaber; 'anakin pod racer' dested Anakin's Podracer; 'out commission' dested Out Of Commission; 'night fall' dested Nightfall.
The strategy says he built the deck after the CA state finals and is 15-1 with it; no tournament finish is claimed.
A later version by the same author is DeckTech 16493 ('WYS that makes you pay every thing', 5 June 2001); it swaps one Houjix & Out Of Nowhere for Goo Nee Tay.
